label: Piotroski F-Score
short_definition: Nine-test financial-strength and operating-quality score from 0 to 9.
formula_description: Standard 9-test Piotroski F-Score (0-9), FY vs prior FY. Computed in mapper/quality_score.py -- a composite requiring 9 raw concepts across 2 fiscal years each, doesn't fit this engine's single-period per-role model. Null for financial institutions by design (Piotroski's own methodology needs a classified current/non-current balance sheet + gross margin, which banks don't report).

label: FCF exceeds net income
short_definition: Binary flag: 1 when free cash flow exceeds net income; otherwise 0.
formula_description: 1 if (CFO - CapEx) > Net Income for the fiscal year, else 0. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, per FY year.

label: Gross margin expanding (3Y)
short_definition: Binary flag: 1 when gross margin increased across three consecutive fiscal years.
formula_description: 1 if gross margin strictly increased across the 3 most recent CONSECUTIVE FY years, else 0; null if fewer than 3 consecutive years of data exist. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, one value as of the latest FY only.

label: Receivables reconciliation gap
short_definition: Difference between the balance-sheet receivables movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
formula_description: (Accounts Receivable[FY] - Accounts Receivable[FY-1]) - the company's own reported cash-flow-statement IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable[FY]. A quality-of-earnings cross-check, not a locked ratio -- a large gap flags AR movement the cash-flow statement's own adjustment doesn't explain (e.g. an acquisition/divestiture, reclassification), not necessarily an error. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py -- needs a prior-FY balance-sheet lookup this engine's single-period model can't express.

label: Inventory reconciliation gap
short_definition: Difference between the balance-sheet inventory movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
formula_description: Same cross-check as ar_change_reconciliation_gap, for Inventory. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py.

label: Payables reconciliation gap
short_definition: Difference between the balance-sheet payables movement and the cash-flow disclosure.
formula_description: Same cross-check as ar_change_reconciliation_gap, for Accounts Payable. Computed in mapper/reconciliation.py.

label: Effective tax-rate gap
short_definition: Difference between the reported effective tax rate and the rate derived from tax expense.
formula_description: Reported Effective Tax Rate - (Income Tax Expense / Income Before Tax). A cross-validation signal for ROIC's own internally-derived tax rate -- a large gap flags a company with material discrete tax items (one-time credits/charges) that year, not necessarily an error in either figure. Computed in mapper/tax_reconciliation.py.

label: Cash conversion (CFO / Net income)
short_definition: Cash from operations relative to net income -- an earnings-quality signal.
formula_description: Cash from Operations / Net Income -- an earnings-quality signal (a real, cash-backed profit should track CFO closely; a large or growing gap flags aggressive accrual accounting).
